title: Decision: workspace resolver = 2 for stricter dependency resolution
description: Cargo resolver = "2" enforces strict dependency resolution across the monorepo, preventing version skew where different crates end up with incompatible transitive dependencies. This is non-negotiable for a multi-crate project and prevents entire classes of version-mismatch bugs that are silent under resolver v1.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — this is a rationale note affirming a correct existing decision (resolver=2 is required for multi-crate workspaces), not a complaint or finding. Filed as 'review' label, type task. No action needed.
